title: PhoneBox: free Stream Deck alternative
caption:
Elgato's Stream Deck costs $149.99. PhoneBox turns the old phone in your drawer into a touch deck for free 📱

✅ PC stats on your desk: CPU, GPU, RAM, network
✅ Touch keys for apps, shortcuts and macros
✅ Music controls, plus OBS and mic controls
✅ 124 widgets and 30 ready-made layouts

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux (PC) + Android 5+ (phone)
ℹ️ It needs an Android phone (no iPhone) and a one-time setup: USB debugging or Wi-Fi pairing. It's a touchscreen, not physical keys, and the fullest audio and OBS controls are on Windows. Stream Deck's $149.99 is the one-time price of the 15-key hardware

Comment "PANEL" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
